payload.title: File:Scyllacerta creanae (skull reconstruction, labeled).png
payload.description_html:
Line reconstruction of the skull of Scyllacerta creanae based on all individuals of SAM-PK-K7710 in (A) left lateral, (B) dorsal, (C) anterior, (D) occipital, and (E) palatal views. Abbreviations: art, articular; an, angular; bo, basioccipital; c, coronoid; d, dentary; ect, ectopterygoid; ep, epipterygoid; f, frontal; hy, hyoid; j, jugal; l, lacrimal; m, maxilla; n, nasal; op, opisthotic; p, parietal; pal, palatine; pbs, parabasisphenoid; pm, premaxilla; po, postorbital; pof, postfrontal; pp, postparietal; pra, prearticular; prf, prefrontal; pr, prootic; pt, pterygoid; q, quadrate; qj, quadratojugal; sa, surangular; so, supraoccipital; sp, splenial; sq, squamosal; st, supratemporal; stp, stapes; tab, tabular; v, vomer. Scale bar=5 mm.


See the Supporting Information of Jenkins et al. (2026) for more details of the reconstruction methods.
